name: @forest/fee-payer-vouchers
description: The voucher check, the fee payer's front: at POST /vouchers it lets through to the free Kora one registry row per voucher, a person proof from a note an issuer it trusts signed, under this fee payer's own voucher label, each tier with its own number of vouchers, each voucher spent once; every other request goes to the at-cost Kora unchanged.
